more.usage: Claude usage and this month's budget
usage.title: AI costs
usage.intro: Every time Mon courrier asks Claude something (reading a letter, answering in the chat, translating), the amount of text processed (tokens) and the estimated price are noted here. No message or name is stored.
usage.fakeMode: Demo mode: the AI is simulated, no real calls are made, so nothing is counted.
usage.projected: End of month at this pace: {amount}
usage.perConversation: Average cost per person helped this month: {amount}
usage.budget.title: Monthly budget
usage.budget.noneSet: No budget set. Set one to be warned before a bad surprise.
usage.budget.stopOn: When the budget is reached, the AI stops: chat questions go to volunteers and new letters show as "failed" in the queue, to be answered by hand.
usage.budget.stopOff: When the budget is reached, a warning is shown but the AI keeps working.
usage.budget.help: Maximum to spend per month, in dollars (the currency Anthropic bills in). A warning appears at 80%. Leave empty for no limit.
usage.budget.hardStop: Stop the AI when the budget is reached
usage.budget.hardStopHelp: Nobody is left without an answer: the chat goes to volunteers and new letters arrive as "failed" in the queue, to be handled by hand. The AI restarts automatically next month, or as soon as you raise the budget.
usage.notice.warning: {pct}% of this month's budget is already used.
usage.notice.over: This month's budget is exceeded. The AI keeps working (no automatic stop).
usage.notice.stopped: The AI is paused until next month: chat questions go to volunteers. Raise the budget to restart it.
usage.days.title: Last 30 days
usage.days.empty: No AI calls in this period.
usage.unpriced: {n} calls use a model with no known price: they are not counted in the amounts.
usage.footnote: Amounts estimated from Claude's public prices. The Anthropic Console invoice is the reference.
keys.title: Claude API keys
keys.intro: Add the keys given by partners here, each with its own monthly budget. Claude uses the first key that still has budget, then the next one. The key is encrypted and never shown in full again.
keys.addHelp: Paste the API key created in the Anthropic Console (it starts with sk-ant-). It is encrypted as soon as it is saved.
keys.label: Name (for example the donor)
keys.keyHelp: Only its last 4 characters will stay visible.
keys.limitHelp: When it is reached, the next key is used. Empty = no limit of its own.
keys.removeBody: The key "{label}" will be erased. Spending already made stays counted in the totals.
keys.lastError: Last error: {error}. It will be tried again in 30 minutes.
keys.serverHelp: Used last, when no key above has budget left.
keys.serverNone: No key configured on the server.
keys.noneLeft: No key left: the AI is paused and chat questions go to volunteers. Add a key or raise a budget.

appt.title: Appointments
appt.intro: People ask on WhatsApp for someone to come with them (préfecture, OFII, hospital…) or to fill in a form with them (CAF, ANEF, AME). You only see who it is once you accept.

appt.meetingPointHint: E.g. at the main entrance, 15 min before
appt.acceptedToast: Done, the person has been told.
appt.documentsBody: The person agreed that you see them for this appointment only. Every opening is logged. Access ends one day after the session.
appt.releaseBody: The person will be told and the request will be waiting again for other volunteers.
appt.cancelBody: The person will be told on WhatsApp. The request will not be offered any more.

num.blockBody: No message from this number will be handled any more, and we will send it nothing, reminders included. You can unblock it later.
conv.guardHeld: This number is held by the spam guard: its new messages are not handled.
conv.guardBlocked: This number is blocked: its messages are ignored.

welcome.intro: Thank you for joining the team. Here is what you can do:
welcome.can.conversations: Answer people on WhatsApp from Conversations. You write in French, the translation is automatic.
welcome.can.letters: Check letter explanations before they are sent.
welcome.can.notes: Leave a follow-up note for the other volunteers.
welcome.can.places: Post today's help places (meals, showers, shelter).
welcome.can.appointments: Go with someone to an appointment or help them fill in a form.
welcome.legal: We point people in the right direction, we never give legal advice: not on the chances of a case, nor on what to decide.
welcome.legalAnswer: "I can't tell you, but a legal adviser can help. Come to the drop-in session with the letter."
welcome.legalHandoff: When in doubt, don't answer on the substance and hand over to someone trained.
welcome.practice: The sandbox simulates a phone: write to the bot, send a photo of a letter, see what the person receives. Nothing is sent to anyone.
welcome.practiceNoSandbox: Start by reading a few conversations without answering, and ask an experienced volunteer when you are unsure.
qr.title: Quick replies
qr.emptyAdmin: Add the answers the team often writes.
qr.hint: The text goes into your reply: you can change it before sending. It is translated like the rest.
qr.legalNote: Every volunteer uses these answers: practical information only, never legal advice.
nick.edit: Give a first name or nickname
nick.title: First name or nickname
nick.help: So the team recognises this person. Visible to volunteers who see their conversations, encrypted, and erased if they delete their data.
